_read_me: Where each KnockRoute field lands in Therisma. The visit results (values.outcome and the results block) follow Therisma's final results list. Every other table and column name is a guess until checked against Therisma's real schema (repo therisma/Therisma-app). When it has been checked, set confirmed to true. The copy script refuses to write SQL or touch Therisma while confirmed is false. A column set to null is not copied.

org._note: TODO-confirm: the query must return one row when the org exists. :org is replaced with the org id.

people._note: TODO-confirm: how to find a Therisma user id for an invited person in this org by email. :org and :email are replaced. People must be invited (and have accepted, if Therisma only creates the row then) before the copy runs.
people.lookup_sql: select m.user_id from org_members m join auth.users u on u.id = m.user_id where m.org_id = :org and lower(u.email) = lower(:email) limit 1

former_people._note: People in KnockRoute who are not on Caleb's roster (left the team). Their visits are kept and credited to one placeholder account, with the original name written into the note.

people.id_check_sql: select 1 from org_members m where m.org_id = :org and m.user_id = :id
people._id_check_note: TODO-confirm. For roster rows given a therisma_user_id (placeholder people with no email yet): the copy stops unless each id is a member of the org. :org and :id are replaced.

lists._t65_lists_options: keep = the 9 Turning 65 lists stay as they are. by_month = Turning 65 leads are regrouped into one list per birth month (Turning 65 – Jan 2027, …) so Therisma can show the current months without a birth-month feature.

leads._dob_format_options: KnockRoute stores birth month only, as 196203. yyyymm = keep 196203. yyyy-mm = 1962-03. date = 1962-03-01 (a real date column; the day is made up).

dispositions._note: Every KnockRoute visit becomes one Therisma activity with exactly one built-in result (activities.outcome).
dispositions._deal_cents_note: Deal amount in whole cents. KnockRoute never recorded deal amounts (leads.sale_price is the home sale price from new-homeowner data, not a deal), so this is empty for every copied visit.
dispositions._result_key_note: For office-named results (max 12). KnockRoute has none, so it is never set.

open_items._note: Open appointments and follow-ups (KnockRoute's Agenda). same_table = they stay as dispositions with due_at set and resolved_at empty, as in KnockRoute. separate_table = each one is ALSO written to the table below.

gated_areas._shape_format_options: latlng = KnockRoute's own [[lat,lng],…] open ring, unchanged. geojson = a GeoJSON Polygon object (jsonb), [lng,lat] order, ring closed. wkt = 'SRID=4326;POLYGON((lng lat, …))' text, for a PostGIS geometry column.

values._note: TODO-confirm each against Therisma's allowed values. Left side is KnockRoute.

results._note: Therisma's built-in results (final list, Nov 25 2026). KnockRoute outcomes are mapped onto these in values.outcome.
results._sold_at_door_note: split = a sale logged at the door becomes an appointment at that time plus a Sold update one second later.
results._missing_date_note: An appointment or follow-up with no date gets the visit's own time as its date.
